description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes related to applying patches in a version control system, including apply state management, patch representation, and diff parsing.

classes.name: apply_state
classes.description: Structure holding the state and configuration for applying patches, including options for whitespace handling, verbosity, and file management.

classes.name: patch
classes.description: Structure representing a file patch, including metadata, content fragments, and status flags.

methods.name: apply_parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for applying patches and updates the apply_state accordingly.

methods.name: init_apply_state
methods.description: Initializes the apply_state structure with repository context and prefix.

methods.name: clear_apply_state
methods.description: Resets or frees resources associated with apply_state.

methods.name: check_apply_state
methods.description: Validates the current apply_state, optionally forcing reinitialization.

methods.name: parse_git_diff_header
methods.description: Parses a diff header line to extract patch metadata.

methods.name: release_patch
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a patch structure.

methods.name: apply_all_patches
methods.description: Applies multiple patches based on the current apply_state and command-line arguments.
